thesis: Identified ZivaSkin demand jumped to 100+ eligible patients with no payer denials or attrition, but actual treatment throughput is slow and highly variable, so the launch ramp won't prove out for several quarters.
red_flags: Speed of patient treatment 'significantly varied'; first patients took a 'long time' through the funnel; timelines 'very variable' ~4-5 months; profitability question not directly answered; only 2 patients treated to date.

thesis: Q4 beat plus initial FY26 operating-profit guide of $390-410M (up ~20% vs $328M) on Aerie/OFFLINE acceleration signals durable momentum the market may under-weight given noisy H1 tariff optics.
red_flags: Q1 operating income guided weak at $20-25M with ~80% of profit in H2; gross margin down 30bps; $130M+ annual tariff headwind; outlook excludes recent Supreme Court/tariff developments.

thesis: Record Q1 (TRASM +16.4%, EPS $3.77) is overshadowed by a fuel-driven Q2 loss guide (~1% op margin, -$0.50 EPS) and capacity cuts, while resilient underlying leisure demand and the Sun Country close are the slow variables.
red_flags: Withheld full-year guidance; Q2 guided to a loss on $4.35/gal fuel (+$120M expense vs prior expectations); ASMs cut ~6.5% Q2 and Q3 flat-to-down; near-term earnings step down sharply.

thesis: Revenue +143% and first-ever positive adjusted EBITDA validate the Guild subscription flywheel, but 7 of 10 theatrical releases and their revenue land in H2, so cash-conversion durability won't be visible for weeks; FY still guided to an EBITDA loss.
red_flags: Heavy promotional/vision framing ('flywheel','moat','renaissance','35x TAM'); still guiding full-year EBITDA loss (<=$25M); results acknowledged 'lumpy' with cost/revenue timing mismatch; recent $34.5M dilutive raise to clear a debt-covenant overhang.

thesis: Q4 comp fell -1.6% but a 140bps margin gain and a cautious flat-to-modest FY26 comp guide understate multiple self-help levers (loyalty/credit-card relaunch, new stores, better/best brands, World Cup and 250th tailwinds) plus a disclosed QTD-positive comp.
red_flags: Q4 comp negative with transactions -6.4% (growth all from +5.1% ticket/price); guidance low end assumes negative comp; repeated macro caution on lower/middle-income consumer; leans on external tailwinds (tax refunds, World Cup).

thesis: A messy quarter (revenue miss, FY26 guide cut to $1.85-1.95B, $151M goodwill impairment, SCAR contract terminated) is framed as shutdown/timing-driven, while a record $4.6B YTD order book and a promised 'record Q4' set up FY27.
red_flags: SCAR contract terminated for convenience after failed renegotiation; $151M goodwill impairment on the space business; Q3 missed and full-year guidance lowered; heavy 'commercialization pivot' spin to explain program losses; orders 'shifted to the right.'

thesis: A demand miss (domestic traffic -7%, e-commerce demand -26%) and a revenue-guidance cut are partly masked by a one-time tariff refund lifting pre-tax income; the recovery is a back-half bet (Halloween, 30th anniversary, Harry Potter, Walmart wholesale) amid a CEO transition.
red_flags: Revenue guidance cut; Q1 missed own flat guide; PTI 'raise' is entirely a $7M tariff one-off offsetting lower operating performance; Q2 guided weaker than Q1; e-commerce demand -26% on AI-search disruption; CEO handover mid-year.

thesis: A 9% revenue miss reset FY26 to flat-vs-2025 (from a growth setup), framed as a 'timing air pocket'; the slow variable is whether the large awarded AMI backlog (2.6-3.6M connections) actually deploys in H2 as promised, alongside a new UDlive sewer-monitoring deal.
red_flags: Revenue missed by $15-20M on short-cycle weakness; FY guide reset from growth to 'in line with 2025'; 10% executive salary cut for 6 months (defensive); unusual disclosure of anonymized project detail 'not normally provided' to reassure; Q2 guided down YoY.
